en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin SulEman, from Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Abdullah B in Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said:
‘The Proof of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> upon the servants is the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, and the Proof regarding what is between the servants and Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, is the intellect’.
